notes:
Context: mid-market analytics SaaS with embedded product search and feature recommendations. Evaluating Redwood as primary inference + embeddings provider.

Trial path agreed: quick hosted API POC (2 weeks) -> Dedicated pilot (4 weeks) if hosted meets recall/throughput and security checks. Team is pragmatic about cost but prioritizes predictable latency for interactive product UX.

Key technical requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: nightly batch embeddings (historical backlog ~200k docs), near-real-time incremental indexing (<1s ingest to queryable), online semantic search for product UX.
- Throughput SLOs: during peak: 50 qps embeddings for bulk indexing pipeline; 200 qps query fanout across vector DB for search.
- Latency targets: query p95 <150ms (end-to-end search), embed p95 <120ms for single-doc calls.
- Vector DB: primary preference is Postgres + pgvector (already used internally) but open to Pinecone/Weaviate; needs examples + integration patterns.
- Model preferences: open models first (quantized where possible), fallback to commercial embeddings if quality gap. Interested in Redwood routing for cheaper variants for non-sensitive workloads.
- Data residency: majority NA, but EU customers require EU residency; need region pinning for embeddings and logs.

POC details & success metrics:
- Hosted POC (current): ingest 10k representative docs; measure recall@10 (target >0.72), mean reciprocal rank, p95 latency; run baseline with existing embedding stack.
- Dedicated pilot: reserved capacity to show predictable tail latency under simulated production traffic (indexing + 100 qps search). Expected to demonstrate 20-30% unit cost reduction compared to current self-hosted.

Commercials / procurement:
- Crescent expects mid 6-figure ARR if pilot converts. Finance wants clear TCO comparison (hosted vs dedicated) and a committed capacity price for Dedicated. Forecasting April close if security + pricing align.

Quotes / callouts from stakeholders:
- "We need search results to feel instant — anything above ~200ms and product team will push back." — Head of Product.

poc_plan_summary: Phase 1 (hosted): 2-week ingest + eval (10k docs). Phase 2 (dedicated): 4-week pilot with reserved capacity and A/B traffic routing. Deliverables: recall/latency report, cost-per-embed comparisons, integration guide for pgvector.
